data.content_ref: inline:The connection 11f6f168415a establishes a CONTRADICTION relation between the defense of non-inductive preference (SRC_001/SRC_004) and the critique of unavoidable induction (SRC_002/SRC_005). This relation is REFUTED IF it can be demonstrated that 'preference' acts purely as a static report of current status with no implicit bet on future success, thereby dissolving the pragmatic inconsistency charge leveled by the induction critics.
